$comment: Extensions the DESIGN.md frontmatter schema cannot hold: tonal ramps, the shadow vocabulary, motion, breakpoints, and the narrative. Regenerate alongside DESIGN.md.
antiReference: The category's near-black dashboard with a neon accent, glowing card borders and a grid of same-size stat cards.

series.$comment: Five lightness steps of ONE hue, so every chart survives greyscale and colour-vision deficiency.

elevation.philosophy: Tonal, with one directional cut. No ambient shadow system exists. Surfaces separate by value, by a self-coloured 1px edge, and by an inner top highlight.

burr.role: The scratch ridge: soot displaced to one side of a cut. The house depth treatment, and the reason nothing in this product glows.

lift.role: Reserved for the one element that genuinely floats: the rail when it becomes a drawer. Not available as card decoration.

press.role: A pressed key and a sunken well.

motion.philosophy: One authored moment: the pen advance. Nothing lifts, scales or bounces. Controls change by tone and fill.
rules: All motion is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
No content's existence ever depends on an animation running.
Animate a clip or a width with stable caps, never scaleY on a rounded shape.

signatures.scratch: Every trace is drawn twice: a well-coloured ridge offset 1.1px, then the bright line over it.
signatures.twoPens: The machine pen steps (discrete fetches); the human pen is written (continuous arrival). Channel identity is carried by line character before colour.
signatures.pinFeed: A 22px sprocket gutter down the left edge of a primary record panel, with content padded clear of the cut.
signatures.registrationTick: Exactly one filled 1.4-square fiducial per icon glyph. The invented detail that makes the icon set this product's own.
signatures.panelRuling: 24px instrument ruling, masked at the panel's top and bottom edges and clipped to the panel. The only grid in the product.

namedRules.name: The Value Ramp Rule
namedRules.text: Categorical series are five lightness steps of one hue, never five hues. A chart that needs six colours has too many series.

namedRules.name: The Two Pens Rule
namedRules.text: Colour is never the only encoding. The line's own character carries channel identity, in the plot and in the legend alike.

namedRules.name: The No Glow Rule
namedRules.text: No glow, halo, bloom or zero-offset coloured shadow anywhere. Depth is the scratch ridge, cast in one direction.

namedRules.name: The Data Face Rule
namedRules.text: Tabular is for genuine data only. A monospace worn by eyebrows and captions is the loudest tell that nobody chose the typography.

namedRules.name: The Honest Scale Rule
namedRules.text: Two channels are never forced onto one scale. Each pen's full-scale value is printed, and a clipped sample is marked and its true value stated, never silently cropped.

contrastFloor.$comment: Every pair in DESIGN.md was computed, not eyeballed. --mf-ink-3 at 5.1:1 is the dimmest text permitted, and it is not permitted below 11px.

provenance.fonts: Trench Slab and Tabular, self-hosted woff2, chosen against rendered specimens rather than by reputation
